quarterly_data.quarter: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical press release: release 260729 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MGC-ITEQ Technology Co., Ltd. (Hsinchu County, Taiwan), the joint venture Mitsubishi Gas Chemical (51%) set up in 2022 with ITEQ (49%) to make and sell laminate materials for printed wiring boards, mainly for semiconductor package substrates, resolved at its shareholders' meeting to dissolve; liquidation is expected to complete in October 2026. Company: the business environment changed sharply after the JV was set up and it judged growth in the form originally expected to be difficult, so the two companies agreed to dissolve it; the impact on MGC's results is minor. MGC says it will continue to strengthen its electronics materials business to meet growing semiconductor-market needs.
quarterly_data.figure: JV 51% MGC / 49% ITEQ, set up 2022; liquidation expected October 2026; impact minor
